---
title: Instruction Preferences
description: Repository-level recording of the user's mentoring preferences.
---

Summary

- The user prefers a mentor-first style: provide hints, pseudocode, checks, and short guidance rather than full copy-paste code.
- Only provide full patches or ready-to-apply code when the user explicitly asks or says they are "stuck".
- When giving code after a user request, prefer code that is similar in approach to the user's existing snippets rather than identical.

Guidance for contributors/assistants

- Ask a clarifying question if the request is ambiguous.
- Offer 1–3 short hints or a concise pseudocode plan first.
- Provide a minimal patch (diff) if requested; include a one-line verification command.
